messages:
sam_presales: Quick note on MedSys POC. They want SOC2 summary, ISO scope, and a signed pen-test attestation that calls out EU data residency. Also asking if we can do a private UAT in eu-west for 2 weeks. Need to know what we can share and pricing delta.

tina_account: @leo_security @diane_legal looping you both. MedSys asks for SAML metadata (Okta) for SSO and mutual TLS VPN for the private peering. They'll also request a short network diagram and a one-page evidence usage attestation.

leo_security: We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II executive summary and ISO27001 scope statement. We do not share raw findings or full vuln reports without an NDA. Pen-test attestation can be created stating that a pen-test was performed and that high-level findings were remediated 30 days after report; we must redact sensitive exploit steps. For mutual TLS we'll need to confirm CA chain and cert rotation plan.

customer_claire: Procurement: "please include name of legal signatory for the attestation and whether the attestation will reference specific CVE IDs or just categories of issues". They prefer CVE IDs if available. Also they need a price delta for an EU-dedicated node + data residency surcharge.

billing_bot: Price snippet: EU private UAT node (temporary, 2 weeks) = $3,000 (one-time). Data residency premium = $0.02 per token processed above baseline. VPN/mTLS setup = $1,500 one-time. Add-on: dedicated log retention (30d) = $250/month pro-rated.

leo_security: CVE IDs: We can include CVE IDs only if they are public and not part of a vendor27s proprietary remediation details. Best practice: include CVE IDs and high-level severity buckets, redact PoC steps. If MedSys insists on raw reports we need a mutual NDA + security questionnaire answered and legal sign-off.

diane_legal: Legal signatory: Diane Morris, Head of Legal, Redwood Inference. I can sign the pen-test attestation addressed to MedSys. If the attestation needs company letterhead and a signature scan, allow 48 hours after the final draft. NDA requirement: standard.

sam_presales: For UAT networking options (short):
- Option 1: Temporary VPN with mTLS, quick (2 business days for setup).
- Option 2: Full VPC peering with strict ACLs, longer (5+ business days, infra ticket).
Which do they prefer? Also confirm whether they want SFTP or presigned S3 for evidence transfer.

customer_claire: They prefer mTLS VPN initially and presigned S3 (7d expiry) for the evidence bundle. Procurement: "send a version that lists monthly delta + one-time fees". They can accept redacted CVE list.

leo_security: Agreed on presigned S3 w/ 7-day expiry. Redaction rules: remove customer PII, full stack traces, internal IP ranges and internal employee IDs. Keep CVE IDs and remediation status. Provide a one-paragraph evidence handling attestation requiring MedSys to confirm no redistribution.

sam_presales: Example ephemeral API key policy I'm proposing for the UAT: keys auto-expire after 14 days and are scoped read-only. Snippet we can share with Devs:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_UAT_KEY" https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/ping
```
Keys will be rotated after the UAT window.

tina_account: Action list recap:
1) @leo_security prepare redacted SOC2 exec summary, ISO scope, pen-test attestation draft (include CVE list where public) by 2024-12-01.
2) @diane_legal confirm signatory and sign final attestation within 48h after draft.
3) @billing_bot produce formal amendment with line items (EU node 2-week one-time, data residency premium, VPN setup, log retention) by EOD.
4) @sam_presales prepare presigned S3 transfer plan (7d expiry) and ephemeral key policy.

customer_claire: One last procurement question: will the pen-test attestation explicitly name MedSys as the recipient on the letter? They asked for that language.

diane_legal: Yes, we can address the attestation to MedSys and name them as the requesting party in the opening paragraph. Will confirm final wording on sign-off.

sam_presales: Potential blocker: if MedSys requests full pen-test report, we hit NDA + extended legal/review path (~7-10 business days). Flagging now so procurement can decide.

customer_claire: Understood. We'll take redacted pack + CVE list for now. Please send the amendment and the attestation draft and we'll review asap.

tina_account: Thanks team. I'll consolidate a short email to MedSys with the timeline and next steps once docs and pricing are ready. :white_check_mark:
